name: USA Wire & Cable, Inc.
old_description: USA Wire & Cable, Inc. is a global distributor of electrical wire and cable serving all 50 states and shipping to more than 50 countries. With more than 250 years of combined experience, our personnel have the cable knowledge and experience needed to provide the specification review service relied upon by many of the top engineering and construction firms worldwide.
about:
USA Wire & Cable, Inc. was founded in 1990 in Austin, Texas, as a privately held distributor of electrical wire and cable. The company is led by President Joe Navarro and operates its corporate offices and main distribution warehouse from Central Texas.

The firm distributes a broad range of industrial cable products — including instrumentation, thermocouple, control, tray, portable power, medium voltage, armored, single conductor, and substation cable — sourced from American manufacturers. It maintains cable management staging locations across the country, enabling delivery to any U.S. job site within 48 hours, and offers specification review services backed by more than 200 years of combined staff experience. The company also provides cable cutting, rewinding, and inventory management for large-scale projects.

Its customer base spans utilities, mining, construction, manufacturing, defense, government, oil and gas, and education sectors. The company cites over 100 power plant projects and counts top engineering and construction firms among those relying on its specification review expertise.

USA Wire & Cable positions itself as a master distributor with preferred agreements with major customers, emphasizing relationship-driven service, integrity, and the use of USA-made products to support domestic infrastructure.
